Brownie - Cheesecake Bars
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:57pm

Ingredients




1 pkg. brownie mix
1 egg
1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
1 can sweetened condensed milk
1 (21 oz.) can cherry pie filling

Preparation

1 Prepare brownies as usual, except bake for only 20 minutes. Combine cream cheese, egg and milk. Pour over brownie mixture and bake for another 25 minutes. Cool 2 hours and top with cherries. Enjoy!
